songs.title: 99 Luftballons
songs.why_it_works: Uses basic, everyday vocabulary (colors, balloons, news, horizon) set to a steady, clear beat.

songs.title: Du Hast
songs.why_it_works: Extremely simple grammar centered around basic verb conjugations (haben, fragen, saying yes/no), spoken clearly with heavy repetition.

songs.title: Mutter
songs.why_it_works: Slow, deliberate delivery with short lines and dark but simple vocabulary; every word is easy to hear.

songs.title: Ohne dich
songs.why_it_works: A slow ballad built on short, repeated phrases and clear prepositions (ohne, in, mit).

songs.title: Perfekte Welle
songs.why_it_works: Clear vocals and everyday conversational vocabulary about waiting for the right moment, with a repetitive chorus.

songs.title: Symphonie
songs.why_it_works: Slow tempo, clear vocals, and straightforward sentence structures.

songs.title: Guten Tag
songs.why_it_works: Fun indie pop with clear diction and repetitive phrasing.

songs.title: Muss i denn
songs.why_it_works: Slow tempo, rhyming stanzas, and high repetition ideal for practicing German rhythm.

songs.title: Die Gedanken sind frei
songs.why_it_works: Clear structure and repetitive chorus focusing on foundational concepts.

songs.title: Auf uns
songs.why_it_works: Uplifting anthem with clear pronunciation, centered around common verbs (fliegen, leben, trinken) and simple tenses.

songs.title: Chöre
songs.why_it_works: Very slow, distinct vocal delivery with beginner-friendly vocabulary about daily life.

songs.title: Der Weg
songs.why_it_works: Heartfelt, slow-paced ballad with poetic yet straightforward imagery and clean diction.

songs.title: Mensch
songs.why_it_works: Calm tempo and short, aphoristic lines about being human; rich ideas in simple words.

songs.title: Lila Wolken
songs.why_it_works: Catchy pop-rap with modern everyday vocabulary, short sentences, and strong rhythmic repetition.

songs.title: Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider
songs.why_it_works: Teaches colors and professions using the exact same sentence pattern repeatedly.

songs.title: Komet
songs.why_it_works: Extremely repetitive chorus and conversational verse structures that reflect modern spoken German.

songs.title: Über den Wolken
songs.why_it_works: Unhurried guitar song with crisp diction; vivid everyday scenes told in plain sentences.

songs.title: Wie soll ein Mensch das ertragen
songs.why_it_works: Very slow and quiet, with emotional depth carried by short, plain sentences and many questions.

songs.title: Nur noch kurz die Welt retten
songs.why_it_works: Moderate tempo, clear vocals and everyday phrases with modal verbs (muss, kann) and separable verbs.

songs.title: Küssen kann man nicht alleine
songs.why_it_works: Exceptionally precise, theatrical diction at a relaxed tempo; witty but simple wording.

songs.title: Halt dich an mir fest
songs.why_it_works: Slow duet with clear imperatives and reflexive verbs (sich festhalten), repeated in the chorus.

songs.title: Gewinner
songs.why_it_works: Laid-back tempo and conversational, reflective lines about winning and losing.

songs.title: Pocahontas
songs.why_it_works: Slow and sparse, with plain spoken-German phrasing and lots of repetition.

poems.title: Erlkönig
poems.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
poems.why_it_works: Structured as a dramatic dialogue with short rhyming lines and narrative flow that makes it easy to follow.

poems.title: Gefunden
poems.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
poems.why_it_works: Short poem (20 lines) about finding a flower in the woods using basic vocabulary and an A-B-C-B rhyme scheme.

poems.title: Der Panther
poems.author: Rainer Maria Rilke
poems.why_it_works: Rich visual imagery with short stanzas and a consistent A-B-A-B rhyme scheme.

poems.title: Stufen
poems.author: Hermann Hesse
poems.why_it_works: Uses clean, elegant sentence structures to explore life's stages, making the theme intuitive.

poems.title: Die Loreley
poems.author: Heinrich Heine
poems.why_it_works: Famous for brief, musical lyricism focusing on straightforward emotions and scenery.

poems.title: Sachliche Romanze
poems.author: Erich Kästner
poems.why_it_works: Written in 'Neue Sachlichkeit' style with plain, unadorned, conversational language without complex archaic words.

poems.title: Monolog des Dackels Bläss
poems.author: Joachim Ringelnatz
poems.why_it_works: Lighthearted, humorous verse with short lines and simple vocabulary from a dog's perspective.
